description: This file defines an abstract class 'GrainFaultTransactionTestRunner' that provides various test methods for transaction fault scenarios in Orleans grains, including transaction aborts on exceptions, read-only violations, orphan calls, and exception inner causes.

classes.name: GrainFaultTransactionTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing test methods for transaction fault scenarios in Orleans grains.

methods.name: AbortTransactionOnExceptions
methods.description: Tests that a transaction aborts when an exception occurs during an add-and-throw operation.

methods.name: AbortTransactionOnReadOnlyViolatedException
methods.description: Tests that a transaction aborts when a read-only violation exception occurs.

methods.name: MultiGrainAbortTransactionOnExceptions
methods.description: Tests transaction aborts when multiple grains are involved and an exception occurs.

methods.name: AbortTransactionExceptionInnerExceptionOnlyContainsOneRootCauseException
methods.description: Verifies that the inner exception chain contains only one root cause during transaction abort.

methods.name: AbortTransactionOnOrphanCalls
methods.description: Tests that orphan calls on grains lead to transaction aborts.

methods.name: TestAfterDustSettles
methods.description: Helper method to retry a test action after a brief delay, handling cascading abort exceptions.
